summary: Round 2 closes all nine round-1 findings and I re-verified each against the files, not the author's note. references/evidence.md is now label-clean (check_labels ALL CLEAN when the file is passed explicitly, matching the three passed siblings). SKILL.md line 73 now states the no-window reading as an implementation fact without ranking the Hamilton and Rhea positions, and reads the registry's R-033 'partly' as the algorithmizable column with the contract column quoted correctly. Step 7 states n = 15 events from 12 reversals with the DEV-11 double count. Step 6 and Limitation 6 add the fewer-than-three-swings None condition, which matches confirmation.py lines 162-164. Step 4 and Output say explicitly that the wrapper's signals table carries no LINE_BREAKOUT_* rows and that breakouts are read from the lines table. The description writes Dow lines without quotation marks. confirm.py (still exactly 60 lines) raises a clean argparse error on an empty inner join. make_pair_sample.py gained --check, exits 0 against the committed CSVs, and a test pins the fixtures to their generator. Five new tests cover the pending status at two early ends, the same-side PRIMARY-versus-SUSPECT non_confirmation at --end 2021-06-21 (plus the confirmed BULL_PRIMARY pair eleven sessions earlier), volume_confirms null on a 30-bar window in both JSON and text, the empty-join error, and the generator check. Re-run results: skill pytest 14 passed (the ClickHouse-gated ^DJI/^DJT example test ran and passed, so every quoted status, match date, line count and breakout date in Examples 2 and 3 still holds against data through 2026-11-06); check_labels ALL CLEAN on SKILL.md and on references/evidence.md; check_quotes ALL CLEAN on both; ruff check and ruff format --check clean; the CSV Example 1 output reproduces byte for byte; no absolute paths. All round-1 fidelity conclusions stand (quotes, R-ids, labels, algorithm descriptions against confirmation.py, line.py, contract A6/A7 and Deviations 9 to 13, Step 7 figures against rule_status_table and rule_R3/R6/R7, agent-defined labelling of the 15-session floor and drift filter, side-by-side Hamilton/Rhea presentation). The Resources entry for tests was updated to describe the new assertions. One cosmetic nit remains and does not affect the verdict; a careful domain expert would sign off.
